Contract version: this story builds against Recovery Workbench API Specification v5, `rwb-source-data.yaml` version 5.0.0.

edits.old: - No personal data in events, workflow inputs or logs: the workflow payload holds the business date and the source; the run record holds counts; `case_list_row` holds no customer name, identity number or contact value.
edits.new:
- No personal data in events, workflow inputs or logs: the workflow payload holds the business date and the source; the run record holds counts; `case_list_row` holds no customer name, identity number or contact value.
- Personal data held or read (Data Classification and Personal Data Inventory v5, Fields): `case_list_row.account_key` (DF-RPT-005) and `recovery_case.case_no` (DF-CAS-002) are indirect identifiers, Confidential, shown within the role's scope and masked in UAT; in events and workflow inputs only a reference is carried, and logs hold the id of the read, never the clear key. `owner_user_id` (DF-RPT-010, DF-CAS-009) is a staff identifier, Internal: a user id only, never the person's name. `recovery_case.team_code` (DF-CAS-011) is classed as customer data, Confidential: logs hold a code or an id only, never the customer value.
- Open decisions this story is built on, each on its recommended option (Decision Log v12, Open decisions): DL16, entry at 90 days past due (ASM-1094, ASM-5264); DL17, one case per customer per product with the accounts linked (assumption: Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P1-E1002-APP-18)); DL25, zero reconciliation tolerance (ASM-0728, ASM-0735, ASM-0743, ASM-2602); DL43, the RWB-ACE-001 scope and dates are accepted as written there (ASM-0193, ASM-0737, ASM-0748, ASM-0816).
